create.name: Dr. Dan Siegel
create.bio:
Dr. Dan Siegel is a psychiatrist and educator who studied medicine at Harvard and trained at UCLA, where he became a clinical professor of psychiatry and helped found the university's research centre on mindful awareness. His central project is interpersonal neurobiology, a way of looking at the mind that draws on brain science, attachment research and contemplative practice and treats wellbeing as a matter of integration: linking differentiated parts of ourselves and our relationships. He calls the capacity to perceive one's own and others' inner lives 'mindsight'.

For general readers his best-known contribution is the Wheel of Awareness, a guided reflection that moves attention from the senses, the body and the mind to awareness itself and then to a sense of connection with others; he sets it out in his book Aware and offers recordings of it free on his website. His other books include Mindsight, The Mindful Brain, IntraConnected, and, with Tina Payne Bryson, The Whole-Brain Child, and several have been New York Times bestsellers. With Caroline Welch he founded the Mindsight Institute, which runs online learning, and he speaks widely to educators, parents, clinicians and contemplative audiences. His office is in Santa Monica, California.

books.title: Aware: The Science and Practice of Presence
books.author: Daniel J. Siegel
books.description: Siegel's full guide to the Wheel of Awareness meditation, with the research behind it and reflections on what awareness itself might be. Readers are guided through the practice step by step.

books.title: Mindsight: The New Science of Personal Transformation
books.author: Daniel J. Siegel
books.description: An accessible introduction to his idea of mindsight, the ability to sense and shape one's own inner life and attune to other people, told through stories and simple models of the brain.

books.title: IntraConnected: MWe (Me + We) as the Integration of Self, Identity, and Belonging
books.author: Daniel J. Siegel
books.description: An essay on widening the sense of self beyond the individual body, so that identity includes our relationships and the natural world, which he names 'MWe'.

books.title: The Mindful Brain: Reflection and Attunement in the Cultivation of Well-Being
books.author: Daniel J. Siegel
books.description: Siegel's earlier exploration of mindful awareness, drawing on his own experience of meditation retreats alongside research on attention and attunement.

books.title: Mind: A Journey to the Heart of Being Human
books.author: Daniel J. Siegel
books.description: A personal and scientific inquiry into what the mind is, weaving his own life story with a working definition of mind as something both embodied and relational.

courses.title: Blue Spirit – Wisdom & Wellbeing: The Wisdom and Science of an Open Heart
courses.description: A week-long multi-teacher retreat at Blue Spirit in Nosara, Costa Rica, combining meditation, cognitive science and interpersonal neurobiology, with Dan Siegel among the faculty. Prices depend on the room booked.

free_resources.title: Wheel of Awareness
free_resources.description: Free guided recordings of his Wheel of Awareness practice in several lengths, from a short consolidated version to a full thirty-minute practice and an advanced version. An image of the wheel explains the idea.

free_resources.title: Everyday Mindsight Tools
free_resources.description: Short audio recordings from Dan Siegel on breath awareness, with a talk on why attention to the breath matters. Free on his website.
